icons.name: bell
icons.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original bell shoulder curve transitions into nearly vertical walls. Broad lower lip balances the narrow crown.

icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original Bézier body: shoulders taper into a raised shutter housing; lens is optically lowered to 12.9.

icons.name: folder
icons.description: A rounded folder silhouette with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original rounded outer contour preserves the folder tab and is drawn once. The contour bounds are x=3..21 and y=3..21: at the unchanged 1.75 stroke, visible padding is exactly 2.125 units on all four sides of the 24-unit viewBox. The front-panel upper edge is one straight horizontal stroke at y=10, without retracing the sides or bottom. Lower corners use matching 2.5-unit construction. Existing body/lid part names, stroke defaults and motion recipe are retained for this static review.

icons.name: heart

icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original symmetric lobes with a shallow notch and curved lower point; no rounded-square frame.

icons.name: search

icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original construction from a circle centered at 10.4 and a 45-degree handle. Circular geometry preserves immediate recognition.
